en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hisham Bin Salim, and Hammad, and Ibn Azina, and Ibn Bukeyr, and someone else, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘There is not emancipation unless what is intended by it is the Face of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic’.
